reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000875 (the melody read from 000875a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Carrie E. Rounsefell's dates (1861–1930) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Rounsefell_Carrie (Rounsefell, Carrie E., 1861-1930; its biography line says 1862, so hymnary disagrees with itself); https://hymnsforworship.org/sdah-573-ill-go-want-go/ gives born March 1, 1861, died September 18, 1930; CCEH's page gives only the year 1894. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000875a.nwc).
